_doc: Wave-3 Specialization trees (Fable, 2026-11-10; design in docs/SPECS.md "Wave 3"; the roster in data/specs.json). Seven specs - Necromancer and Warlock (Mage), Weaponmaster (Fighter), Reckoner (Rogue), Dusk Priest (Healer) and the hybrids Druid (Healer OR Mage) and Bard (Healer OR Rogue) - three trees each, 9-10 nodes a tree, levels 10/11/12/14/16/18/20, ranks to 10 (short utilities 3-5). SAME SCHEMA as skills-specs-1/2.json (owner = the spec id, tree = the tree id in specs.json). HYBRIDS: every Bard active carries `altCost` in energy (a Bard from Rogue pays it; from Healer pays cost.mana); the Druid's two Paths BOTH run on mana, so its actives carry no altCost (costOf would pick the same number). STANCES THAT SWAP THE BAR (the engine's `stance.bar`, new since wave 2): the Druid's three shapes, the Weaponmaster's two stances (and the Mastery capstone, a 15 s third one) and the Bard's three songs each carry `bar: [6 ids]` - the six slots become that list while the stance holds, the same stance pressed again leaves it, and a skill on the bar counts as known at rank >= 1 (its learned rank if higher, and only once the hero has reached its reqLevel - skills.js rankOf). A bar lists its OWN stance first (the way out), then that shape's tree actives, plus six `hidden: true` actives (dru_maul, dru_rip, wpm_open_flurry, wpm_closed_flurry, wpm_open_lunge, wpm_closed_lunge: owner + reqLevel like the rest, maxRank 1, no tree, so the tree page never shows them and only a stance grants them; a synergy node can still feed one, e.g. Sharper Fangs -> dru_rip). The stance `stats` the engine reads: damage, crit, castSpeed, healTaken, threat (fxPct), armour + dodge (withArmour), moveSpeed (speedFactor); `stats.perRank` ranks them through atRank. OTHER ENGINE FEATURES USED HERE: `link` (Shared Vigil), `cond: { targetHpBelow }` executes (Marrowburst, Savage Bite, Finishing Overhead, Judgement Bolt, Settle the Grudge), `perDot` (Marrow Lance, Marrowburst, Agony), `perTargetHit` crowds, `zone` ground that heals COMPANIONS too (Grave Mending, Spore Cloud, Circle of Dawn - the helpful zone pool is players + allies), `heal who: self` drains, `shield.thorns` (Bristle, Cinder Shroud, Riposte, Take It), `spendAll` + `perResourceSpent` (Settle the Grudge), `weaponOnly: ranged` (Double Shot, Pinning Shot), summon `pet` (Bone Colossus, the Warlock's three fiends, the Reckoner's two hounds) and `minion` to the eight cap (Thralls, Bone Warden, Plague Thrall, the Buried, Imps, Night Hounds) with synergy damage feeding them, and moveSpeed/dodge buffs now that they are read. NUMBERS as waves 1-2: a spec filler is 1.1-1.3x a swing or ~1.4x a Path bolt, big hits 2.5-4x on 8-25 s cooldowns, capstones at 20 on 20-90 s; costs sit where a Path runs flat out ~30 s then lean (temper 15-50, energy 20-50, mana 14-60). A stance costs almost nothing (Druid 10 mana, Weaponmaster 0, Bard 20) because you press it to leave too. Everything here runs on the engine today except the ideas in `wishlist`, each written as its fallback.

nec_raise_thrall.name: Raise Thrall
nec_raise_thrall.desc: Two thralls climb out of the ground and fight for you until they are cut down. Up to eight at once; the oldest makes room. Ranks make them tougher and sharper. Your opener and your filler both.

nec_dead_calm.name: Dead Calm
nec_dead_calm.desc: The dead do not hurry, and neither do you. Mana comes back faster.

nec_bone_warden.name: Bone Warden
nec_bone_warden.desc: Raise one big one: a warden of bone that shouts the pack onto itself every few seconds and hardens when it is hurt. Counts as a thrall.

nec_grave_mending.name: Grave Mending
nec_grave_mending.desc: The ground under you knits the dead back together: for {secs} seconds everyone standing within 6 m of where you cast it, thralls and friends alike, is mended every second.

nec_command_dead.name: Command the Dead
nec_command_dead.desc: Point, and the dead go: a cold touch for {dmg} shadow damage that strips a fifth of the target's armour for 8 seconds, and your thralls turn on it. Does not use the global cooldown.

nec_plague_thrall.name: Plague Thrall
nec_plague_thrall.desc: Raise a thrall that is mostly rot: when enemies bunch up it bursts with poison over 3 m, and it claws like the rest. Counts as a thrall.

nec_grave_hardy.name: Grave Hardy
nec_grave_hardy.desc: You have stood in a lot of graveyards. More health.

nec_fouler_rot.name: Fouler Rot
nec_fouler_rot.desc: Plague Thralls burst harder per rank.

nec_bone_colossus.name: Bone Colossus
nec_bone_colossus.desc: Build one great thing out of everything you have raised: a colossus of bone that stays with you, holds a pack by itself and hits like a boss. One at a time; it does not count against your thralls. The Thralls capstone.

nec_marrow_lance.name: Marrow Lance
nec_marrow_lance.desc: A lance of sharpened bone for {dmg} shadow damage, 20% more for every curse or poison already on the target (up to +60%). A short cast; your spell filler.

nec_wither.name: Wither
nec_wither.desc: A curse that eats {dmg} shadow damage a second for 10 seconds and leaves the target hitting 10% softer for 6. Instant.

nec_grave_draught.name: Grave Draught
nec_grave_draught.desc: Drink from the target: {dmg} shadow damage, and you are healed for most of it. Instant.

nec_deeper_marrow.name: Deeper Marrow
nec_deeper_marrow.desc: Marrow Lance hits harder per rank.

nec_bone_spur.name: Bone Spur
nec_bone_spur.desc: A spur of bone through the throat: stops what the target is casting, locks it for 3 seconds and silences it for one, with {dmg} shadow damage. Does not use the global cooldown.

nec_bone_storm.name: Bone Storm
nec_bone_storm.desc: Shards of bone burst from the target over 5 m: {dmg} shadow damage to everything inside, more the more it hits (up to +40%), and a curse ticking on each of them for 6 seconds.

nec_siphon.name: Siphon
nec_siphon.desc: Pull {dmg} shadow damage out of the target and 12 mana back into yourself. Instant.

nec_marrowburst.name: Marrowburst
nec_marrowburst.desc: Every curse on the target comes due at once: {dmg} shadow damage, +30% per curse or poison on it (up to +120%), half again if it is under 35% health, and it is stunned for 1.5 seconds. The Marrow capstone.

nec_corpse_pyre.name: Corpse Pyre
nec_corpse_pyre.desc: Light the ground where you point it: a 4 m pyre that burns everything standing in it for {dmg} fire damage a second for 6 seconds. Lands at the pointer.

nec_ember_bones.name: Ember Bones
nec_ember_bones.desc: The target's bones catch: {dmg} fire damage to everything within 5 m of it, and it keeps burning for 6 seconds.

nec_quick_rites.name: Quick Rites
nec_quick_rites.desc: You have said the words a thousand times. Faster casting.

nec_unquiet_return.name: Unquiet Return
nec_unquiet_return.desc: Drag a fallen friend back through the grave: they stand at {dmg}% health inside a ward, angry, hitting 15% harder for 10 seconds. A long cast, and the grave will not give them up while you are fighting.

nec_hotter_pyre.name: Hotter Pyre
nec_hotter_pyre.desc: Corpse Pyre burns harder per rank.

nec_pyre_wall.name: Pyre Wall
nec_pyre_wall.desc: A line of fire 10 m long out from you: {dmg} fire damage to everything in it and a 40% slow for 3 seconds.

nec_cinder_shroud.name: Cinder Shroud
nec_cinder_shroud.desc: Wrap yourself in embers: a {dmg} ward for 8 seconds that burns whatever hits you for fire damage.

nec_wider_pyre.name: Wider Pyre
nec_wider_pyre.desc: Corpse Pyre covers more ground per rank.

nec_march_of_buried.name: March of the Buried
nec_march_of_buried.desc: The ground heaves. Four of the buried climb out through the fire and fight for 20 seconds, and everything within 8 m of you is burned for {dmg} fire damage and slowed. They count as thralls. The Pyre capstone.

wlk_gnaw.name: Gnawing Curse
wlk_gnaw.desc: A curse that gnaws {dmg} shadow damage a second for 12 seconds, with a bite as it lands. Instant; your filler, and the thing every other curse builds on.

wlk_blight.name: Blight
wlk_blight.desc: A second curse, poison this time: {dmg} a second for 10 seconds, and the target hits 10% softer for 8. Stacks with Gnawing Curse.

wlk_long_night.name: Long Night
wlk_long_night.desc: Gnawing Curse lasts longer per rank.

wlk_soul_drain.name: Soul Drain
wlk_soul_drain.desc: Hold the target in a 3 second drain: {dmg} shadow damage a second, and each second heals you and gives back 4 mana.

wlk_spreading_rot.name: Spreading Rot
wlk_spreading_rot.desc: The curse jumps: {dmg} shadow damage to everything within 6 m of the target, and a curse ticking on each of them for 8 seconds.

wlk_deeper_gnaw.name: Deeper Gnaw
wlk_deeper_gnaw.desc: Gnawing Curse eats more per rank.

wlk_agony.name: Agony
wlk_agony.desc: Make the curses hurt all at once: {dmg} shadow damage, +35% for every curse or poison on the target (up to +140%).

wlk_soul_pact.name: Soul Pact
wlk_soul_pact.desc: Sign it in your own blood: for 12 seconds your spells hit 25% harder and cast 20% faster, 40 mana comes back, and every curse within 8 m of you flares for {dmg} shadow damage and keeps burning. The Gnawing Dark capstone.

wlk_bind_fiend.name: Bind the Fiend
wlk_bind_fiend.desc: Call the fiend you made a deal with. It stays with you until it falls, rakes what you fight and howls a pack onto itself when you are in trouble. Ranks make it tougher and meaner.

wlk_fiends_hide.name: Fiend's Hide
wlk_fiends_hide.desc: Some of its hide rubbed off on you. More health.

wlk_fouler_fiend.name: Fouler Fiend
wlk_fouler_fiend.desc: The fiend hits harder per rank.

wlk_fiend_fire.name: Fiend Fire
wlk_fiend_fire.desc: Borrow the fiend's breath: {dmg} fire damage, and the target burns for 6 seconds. Instant.

wlk_sacrifice.name: Sacrifice
wlk_sacrifice.desc: The fiend lends you its skin: a {dmg} ward for 8 seconds that burns whatever hits you, and 20 mana back. Does not use the global cooldown.

wlk_fiend_hunger.name: Fiend's Hunger
wlk_fiend_hunger.desc: Every blow feeds you a little. Life on hit.

wlk_void_hound.name: Void Hound
wlk_void_hound.desc: Call a bigger thing in place of the fiend: a hound of the void that holds a pack on itself, bites hard and hardens when hurt. One pet at a time.

wlk_imps.name: Imps
wlk_imps.desc: Two imps for {secs} seconds, throwing fire at whatever you fight. They count as minions, not as your pet.

wlk_voidhide.name: Voidhide
wlk_voidhide.desc: The Void Hound bites harder per rank.

wlk_fiend_lord.name: Fiend Lord
wlk_fiend_lord.desc: Call the one the others answer to: a fiend lord that rakes, breathes fire over a crowd and holds a pack, and while it stands you hit 15% harder. One pet at a time. The Fiend capstone.

wlk_rift_bolt.name: Rift Bolt
wlk_rift_bolt.desc: A bolt of nothing for {dmg} shadow damage. A short cast; the plain spell for when the curses are already on.

wlk_void_rift.name: Void Rift
wlk_void_rift.desc: Tear a rift where you point: everything within 6 m is dragged 5 m toward you, takes {dmg} shadow damage and is slowed for 3 seconds. Lands at the pointer. The pack ends up in one place.

wlk_rift_step.name: Rift Step
wlk_rift_step.desc: Step through a rift 10 m ahead of you with a {dmg} ward for 4 seconds. Does not use the global cooldown.

wlk_wider_rift.name: Wider Rift
wlk_wider_rift.desc: Void Rift reaches further per rank.

wlk_hush_dark.name: Hush
wlk_hush_dark.desc: The dark swallows the words: stops what the target is casting, locks it for 3 seconds and silences it for one, with {dmg} shadow damage. Does not use the global cooldown.

wlk_collapse.name: Collapse
wlk_collapse.desc: The rift closes on them: {dmg} shadow damage to everything within 5 m of the target, more the more it hits (up to +40%), and a 1 second stun.

wlk_blood_burst.name: Blood Burst
wlk_blood_burst.desc: Everything you have, through the rift at once: {dmg} shadow damage to the target, a burst over 6 m round it that stuns for a second, and a curse on everything the burst touched. The Rift capstone.

dru_briarback.name: Briarback
dru_briarback.desc: Take the thorned shape: +30% armour, you hold attention far better, and you move a little slower and hit a little softer with spells. Your six slots become the Briarback's claws, thorns and roar while it holds. Press again to come back.

dru_thick_hide.name: Thick Hide
dru_thick_hide.desc: Bark under the skin. Your armour counts for more.

dru_thornlash.name: Thornlash
dru_thornlash.desc: A lash of thorns for {mult} weapon damage that pulls the target onto you, and a small ward of briars that pricks whatever hits you for 4 seconds. The Briarback's filler.

dru_bristle.name: Bristle
dru_bristle.desc: Every thorn stands up: a {dmg} ward for 8 seconds that stabs whatever hits you for poison damage, and +20% armour while it holds.

dru_bark_roar.name: Bark Roar
dru_bark_roar.desc: A roar that turns everything within 10 m on you and leaves it hitting 10% softer for 6 seconds. Does not use the global cooldown.

dru_root_stomp.name: Root Stomp
dru_root_stomp.desc: Stamp, and roots burst up through everything within 5 m: {mult} weapon damage and a 2 second hold.

dru_thornhide.name: Thornhide
dru_thornhide.desc: Bristle wards for more per rank.

dru_ancient_bark.name: Ancient Bark
dru_ancient_bark.desc: Become the oldest tree in the wood: a {dmg} ward for 10 seconds that stabs back hard, +40% armour, a heal for yourself, and everything within 8 m turns on you and is slowed. The Briarback capstone.

dru_maul.name: Maul
dru_maul.desc: The Briarback's plain swing: {mult} weapon damage and a bleed for 6 seconds. Yours while the shape holds.

dru_fenrunner.name: Fenrunner
dru_fenrunner.desc: Take the wolf shape: 25% faster, +10% critical chance, +10 dodge. Your six slots become the Fenrunner's teeth while it holds. Press again to come back.

dru_light_paws.name: Light Paws
dru_light_paws.desc: Faster on your feet, in every shape.

dru_lunge.name: Lunge
dru_lunge.desc: Cover 10 m in a bound and bite for {mult} weapon damage. Works in any shape: lunge in, then change.

dru_hamstring.name: Hamstring
dru_hamstring.desc: Teeth in the back of the leg: {mult} weapon damage and a 40% slow for 4 seconds.

dru_savage_bite.name: Savage Bite
dru_savage_bite.desc: The killing bite: {mult} weapon damage, half again on anything under 35% health.

dru_howl.name: Howl
dru_howl.desc: Everyone in the party hits 10% harder for 10 seconds, and everything within 6 m of you hits 10% softer for 6.

dru_blood_scent.name: Blood Scent
dru_blood_scent.desc: Savage Bite bites harder per rank.

dru_wild_hunt.name: Wild Hunt
dru_wild_hunt.desc: Run through the pack: {mult} weapon damage to everything within 6 m, more the more you hit (up to +40%), and every one of them bleeds for 6 seconds. The Fenrunner capstone.

dru_rip.name: Rip
dru_rip.desc: The Fenrunner's plain bite: {mult} weapon damage and a bleed for 8 seconds. Yours while the shape holds.

dru_sporecap.name: Sporecap
dru_sporecap.desc: Take the mushroom shape: you cast 15% faster and are a little tougher. Your six slots become the Sporecap's spores and blooms while it holds. Press again to come back.

dru_greensap.name: Greensap
dru_greensap.desc: Sap into the wound: {dmg} healing on a friend and a little more every second for 6. A short cast; works in any shape.

dru_spore_cloud.name: Spore Cloud
dru_spore_cloud.desc: A cloud of mending spores 5 m across where you point: everyone standing in it, companions too, is healed for {dmg} every second for 8 seconds. Lands at the pointer.

dru_bloom.name: Bloom
dru_bloom.desc: Everything within 8 m of you flowers: {dmg} healing on every friend there and their poisons, slows and holds shaken off.

dru_richer_sap.name: Richer Sap
dru_richer_sap.desc: Greensap heals for more per rank.

dru_sporeburst.name: Sporeburst
dru_sporeburst.desc: Lob a cap that bursts on the target: {dmg} poison damage to everything within 5 m, a 30% slow for 3 seconds, and the target keeps choking for 8.

dru_green_return.name: Green Return
dru_green_return.desc: Grow a fallen friend back up through the moss: they stand at {dmg}% health, mending for 8 seconds, inside a ward. A long cast; come back to your own shape to do it, and not while you are fighting.

dru_great_bloom.name: Great Bloom
dru_great_bloom.desc: The whole glade flowers at once: {dmg} healing on every friend within 12 m, mending for 8 seconds after, every ill shaken off, and heals land 15% harder on them for 10. The Sporecap capstone.

wpm_open_stance.name: Open Stance
wpm_open_stance.desc: Drop the guard and open up: +12% damage and +6% critical chance, at -15% armour. Your six slots become the open stance's cuts (its own lunge and flurry among them) while it holds. Press again to stand easy.

wpm_quick_cut.name: Quick Cut
wpm_quick_cut.desc: A fast cut for {mult} weapon damage. The open stance's filler.

wpm_pierce.name: Pierce
wpm_pierce.desc: A thrust through the plates: {mult} weapon damage and the target's armour down 15% for 8 seconds.

wpm_sharper_cut.name: Sharper Cut
wpm_sharper_cut.desc: Quick Cut cuts deeper per rank.

wpm_blade_dance.name: Blade Dance
wpm_blade_dance.desc: A turning cut through everything within 5 m: {mult} weapon damage each, more the more you hit (up to +40%).

wpm_faster_dance.name: Faster Dance
wpm_faster_dance.desc: Blade Dance hits harder per rank.

wpm_perfect_edge.name: Perfect Edge
wpm_perfect_edge.desc: For 10 seconds every cut is the right one: +25% damage, +20% critical chance, 40 temper, and a sweep for {mult} weapon damage that stuns everything within 5 m for a second. The Open Stance capstone.

wpm_closed_stance.name: Closed Stance
wpm_closed_stance.desc: Close up behind the blade: +30% armour, +6 dodge, you hold attention better, and you hit 10% softer. Your six slots become the closed stance's guards and counters (its own lunge and flurry among them) while it holds. Press again to stand easy.

wpm_riposte.name: Riposte
wpm_riposte.desc: Take the blow on the blade and answer it: {mult} weapon damage and a small ward for 4 seconds that strikes back at whatever hits you. The closed stance's filler.

wpm_sweeping_guard.name: Sweeping Guard
wpm_sweeping_guard.desc: A wide parry turned into a cut: {mult} weapon damage to everything in a 120 degree arc, they hit 15% softer for 5 seconds, and a ward on you.

wpm_sure_riposte.name: Sure Riposte
wpm_sure_riposte.desc: Riposte wards for more per rank.

wpm_iron_counter.name: Iron Counter
wpm_iron_counter.desc: The counter they walked into: {mult} weapon damage, a 1 second stun, and a ward on you for 4.

wpm_harder_counter.name: Harder Counter
wpm_harder_counter.desc: Iron Counter hits harder per rank.

wpm_unbroken_guard.name: Unbroken Guard
wpm_unbroken_guard.desc: Nothing gets through for 8 seconds: a {dmg} ward that strikes back hard, +40% armour, everything within 8 m turns on you and is slowed, and 30 temper. The Closed Stance capstone.

wpm_lunge.name: Lunge
wpm_lunge.desc: Cover 8 m and cut for {mult} weapon damage. In the open stance the lunge cuts deeper and opens the armour; in the closed one it lands flat and stuns.

wpm_flurry.name: Flurry
wpm_flurry.desc: Three cuts in one breath for {mult} weapon damage each. In the open stance they are heavier; in the closed one they are lighter and leave a guard up.

wpm_disarming_cut.name: Disarming Cut
wpm_disarming_cut.desc: A cut at the hands: stops what the target is casting, locks it for 3 seconds and silences it for one, with {mult} weapon damage. Does not use the global cooldown.

wpm_overhead.name: Finishing Overhead
wpm_overhead.desc: Both hands over the head and down: {mult} weapon damage, half again on anything under 35% health.

wpm_deeper_overhead.name: Deeper Overhead
wpm_deeper_overhead.desc: Finishing Overhead hits harder per rank.

wpm_stance_master.name: Master of Stances
wpm_stance_master.desc: Both stances at once for 15 seconds: +15% damage, +8% critical chance, +25% armour and +6 dodge, and a bar that holds the open flurry, the closed lunge, Quick Cut, Iron Counter and the Overhead. The Mastery capstone.

wpm_open_flurry.name: Open Flurry
wpm_open_flurry.desc: Flurry, the open way: three heavy cuts for {mult} weapon damage each. Yours while the open stance holds.

wpm_closed_flurry.name: Closed Flurry
wpm_closed_flurry.desc: Flurry, the closed way: three light cuts for {mult} weapon damage each behind a {dmg} ward. Yours while the closed stance holds.

wpm_open_lunge.name: Open Lunge
wpm_open_lunge.desc: Lunge, the open way: 8 m and a deep cut for {mult} weapon damage that opens the armour 10% for 6 seconds. Yours while the open stance holds.

wpm_closed_lunge.name: Closed Lunge
wpm_closed_lunge.desc: Lunge, the closed way: 8 m and a flat blow for {mult} weapon damage that stuns for a second and turns the target on you. Yours while the closed stance holds.

rck_brand_bolt.name: Brand Bolt
rck_brand_bolt.desc: A shot, or a cut, for {mult} weapon damage that brands the target: it takes 12% more from everything for 8 seconds. Your filler at range.

rck_searing_brand.name: Searing Brand
rck_searing_brand.desc: The brand catches fire: {dmg} fire damage a second for 8 seconds, with a flash as it lands. Instant, from 20 m.

rck_long_brand.name: Long Brand
rck_long_brand.desc: Brand Bolt's brand lasts longer per rank.

rck_double_shot.name: Double Shot
rck_double_shot.desc: Two bolts off the string for {mult} weapon damage each. Needs a crossbow or bow.

rck_brand_burst.name: Brand Burst
rck_brand_burst.desc: Every brand in reach goes off: {dmg} fire damage to everything within 5 m of the target, more the more it hits (up to +40%), and a 30% slow for 3 seconds.

rck_hotter_brand.name: Hotter Brand
rck_hotter_brand.desc: Searing Brand burns harder per rank.

rck_pinning_shot.name: Pinning Shot
rck_pinning_shot.desc: A bolt through the foot: {mult} weapon damage and a 2 second hold. Needs a crossbow or bow.

rck_judgement_bolt.name: Judgement Bolt
rck_judgement_bolt.desc: The one shot you were saving: {mult} weapon damage, half again on anything under 35% health, and a burst of fire over 4 m round it. The Brand capstone.

rck_chain_hook.name: Chain Hook
rck_chain_hook.desc: Throw the hook and haul: the target is dragged 8 m to you, cut for {mult} weapon damage and slowed for 2 seconds. From 15 m.

rck_tumbling_shot.name: Tumbling Shot
rck_tumbling_shot.desc: Hit for {mult} weapon damage and tumble 6 m back behind a small ward. Does not use the global cooldown.

rck_unleash_hound.name: Unleash the Hound
rck_unleash_hound.desc: Let the hound off the chain. It stays with you until it falls, bites what you fight, breaks their casting, and harries them so they cannot run. Ranks make it tougher and sharper.

rck_hard_bite.name: Hard Bite
rck_hard_bite.desc: The hound bites harder per rank.

rck_snare.name: Snare
rck_snare.desc: A snare 4 m across where you point it: everything in it is held for 2 seconds and cut for {dmg}. Lands at the pointer.

rck_hook_and_drag.name: Hook and Drag
rck_hook_and_drag.desc: Hooks into everything within 6 m of where you point: all of it dragged 6 m toward you, cut for {dmg}, and slowed 40% for 3 seconds. Lands at the pointer.

rck_fury_hound.name: Fury Hound
rck_fury_hound.desc: A bigger hound in place of the first: more bite, a snap that breaks casting, a lunge through a crowd, and a bay that pulls a pack onto it. One pet at a time.

rck_night_hunt.name: Night Hunt
rck_night_hunt.desc: The hunt is up: for 12 seconds you hit 20% harder, crit 15% more and run 30% faster, 40 energy comes back, and two night hounds run with you for 15. The Hook capstone.

rck_grudge_cut.name: Grudge Cut
rck_grudge_cut.desc: A cut for {mult} weapon damage that pays a little of what you took back into you. Your filler up close.

rck_take_it.name: Take It
rck_take_it.desc: Take the hit and remember it: a {dmg} ward for 6 seconds that cuts back at whatever hits you, and 10 energy. Does not use the global cooldown.

rck_payback.name: Payback
rck_payback.desc: What they gave you, with interest: {mult} weapon damage, and the target hits 10% softer for 6 seconds.

rck_reckoners_word.name: Reckoner's Word
rck_reckoners_word.desc: Name the debt: stops what the target is casting, locks it for 3 seconds, silences it for one, cuts for {mult} weapon damage and brands it for 6. From 15 m; does not use the global cooldown.

rck_grim_resolve.name: Grim Resolve
rck_grim_resolve.desc: Grit your teeth: +30% armour for 8 seconds, a heal for {dmg}, and every poison, slow and hold shaken off.

rck_settle_grudge.name: Settle the Grudge
rck_settle_grudge.desc: Spend every point of energy you have on one blow: {mult} weapon damage, +2% more for every point past the cost, half again on anything under 35% health. The Reckoning capstone.

dsk_shadow_lance.name: Shadow Lance
dsk_shadow_lance.desc: A lance of dusk for {dmg} shadow damage, and as it lands a little light falls on every friend within 10 m of you. A short cast; your filler, and a solo Dusk Priest still clears with it.

dsk_twinlight.name: Twinlight
dsk_twinlight.desc: Both at once: {dmg} shadow damage to the target, and the light of it heals every friend within 10 m of you. Instant.

dsk_gloaming.name: Gloaming
dsk_gloaming.desc: Shadow Lance hits harder per rank.

dsk_dusk_wave.name: Dusk Wave
dsk_dusk_wave.desc: A wave of dusk through everything in front of you: {dmg} shadow damage, they hit 10% softer for 5 seconds, and friends within 8 m are healed.

dsk_shadow_word.name: Shadow Word
dsk_shadow_word.desc: A word that gnaws {dmg} shadow damage a second for 10 seconds, and while it gnaws, every friend within 10 m of you mends a little each second for 6.

dsk_kindled_shade.name: Kindled Shade
dsk_kindled_shade.desc: Twinlight heals for more per rank.

dsk_eventide.name: Eventide
dsk_eventide.desc: The sun goes down on them: {dmg} shadow damage and a 1.5 second stun, and the last light heals every friend within 12 m of you and keeps mending them for 6 seconds. The Twinlight capstone.

dsk_vigil.name: Vigil
dsk_vigil.desc: Keep watch over a friend: a {dmg} ward for 10 seconds and a little mending each second under it. Instant; paid before the blow, not after.

dsk_shared_vigil.name: Shared Vigil
dsk_shared_vigil.desc: Take a share of it: for 10 seconds a third of every hit the friend takes falls on you instead, after your own armour, and they carry a {dmg} ward.

dsk_keep_watch.name: Keep Watch
dsk_keep_watch.desc: Vigil wards for more per rank.

dsk_lamplight.name: Lamplight
dsk_lamplight.desc: A lamp over everyone: a {dmg} ward on every friend within 10 m for 8 seconds.

dsk_second_dawn.name: Second Dawn
dsk_second_dawn.desc: A fallen friend within 20 m gets up at {dmg}% health inside a ward. Two seconds of prayer; the dawn does not come while you are fighting.

dsk_dusk_ward.name: Dusk Ward
dsk_dusk_ward.desc: Shake every poison, slow and hold off a friend, heal them for {dmg}, and heals land 15% harder on them for 8 seconds.

dsk_night_vigil.name: Night Vigil
dsk_night_vigil.desc: A vigil over everyone: a {dmg} ward on every friend within 12 m for 10 seconds, mending under it for 8, every ill shaken off, and +20% armour on the party. The Vigil capstone.

dsk_dawn_prayer.name: Dawn Prayer
dsk_dawn_prayer.desc: {dmg} healing on a friend and a small ward over the top of it. A short cast; the plain heal.

dsk_mark_the_killer.name: Mark the Killer
dsk_mark_the_killer.desc: Mark whatever is hurting your friends: {dmg} shadow damage, and it takes 15% more from everyone for 8 seconds. Instant.

dsk_circle_of_dawn.name: Circle of Dawn
dsk_circle_of_dawn.desc: Light on the ground 6 m across where you point: everyone standing in it, companions too, is healed for {dmg} every second for 8 seconds. Lands at the pointer.

dsk_brighter_prayer.name: Brighter Prayer
dsk_brighter_prayer.desc: Dawn Prayer heals for more per rank.

dsk_hush.name: Hush
dsk_hush.desc: Stops what the target is casting, locks it for 3 seconds and silences it for one, with {dmg} shadow damage. Does not use the global cooldown.

dsk_wider_circle.name: Wider Circle
dsk_wider_circle.desc: Circle of Dawn covers more ground per rank.

dsk_daybreak.name: Daybreak
dsk_daybreak.desc: The sun comes up on everyone within 10 m: {dmg} healing and every poison, slow and hold shaken off. Instant.

dsk_first_light.name: First Light
dsk_first_light.desc: Dawn and dusk in one breath: {dmg} healing on every friend within 12 m and mending for 8 seconds after, and everything within 8 m of you takes shadow damage and is stunned for a second. The Dawn capstone.

brd_song_of_valour.name: Song of Valour
brd_song_of_valour.desc: Strike up the song that speeds and strengthens: everyone in the party hits 8% harder for 20 seconds as it opens, and while you sing it you hit 10% harder and move 10% faster. Your six slots become the Valour verses while it holds. Press again to stop; one song at a time.

brd_bold_strike.name: Bold Strike
brd_bold_strike.desc: A cut in time with the song for {mult} weapon damage, and +10% critical chance for 8 seconds. The Valour filler.

brd_marching_verse.name: Marching Verse
brd_marching_verse.desc: The verse that gets everyone moving: the party runs 25% faster and crits 10% more for 10 seconds.

brd_louder_valour.name: Louder Valour
brd_louder_valour.desc: Marching Verse lasts longer per rank.

brd_war_chorus.name: War Chorus
brd_war_chorus.desc: The whole party joins in: +15% damage for 12 seconds, and a {dmg} ward on every friend within 8 m.

brd_sharper_strike.name: Sharper Strike
brd_sharper_strike.desc: Bold Strike cuts deeper per rank.

brd_valour_finale.name: Valour Finale
brd_valour_finale.desc: The song's finale: friends within 8 m are healed for {dmg}, the party hits 25% harder and casts 20% faster for 10 seconds, and the last chord stuns everything within 6 m of you for a second. The Valour capstone.

brd_song_of_ruin.name: Song of Ruin
brd_song_of_ruin.desc: Strike up the song that curses: everything within 8 m hits 8% softer for 10 seconds as it opens, and while you sing it you crit 8% more and cast 10% faster. Your six slots become the Ruin verses while it holds. Press again to stop; one song at a time.

brd_discord_note.name: Discord Note
brd_discord_note.desc: A note that hurts: {dmg} storm damage, and the target hits 8% softer for 4 seconds. Instant, from 25 m; your filler in any song.

brd_cursed_verse.name: Cursed Verse
brd_cursed_verse.desc: A verse with the target's name in it: {dmg} shadow damage a second for 10 seconds, and it hits 10% softer for 8.

brd_dirge.name: Dirge
brd_dirge.desc: A dirge over the ground you point at: {dmg} shadow damage to everything within 6 m and a 30% slow for 4 seconds. Lands at the pointer.

brd_longer_curse.name: Longer Curse
brd_longer_curse.desc: Cursed Verse lasts longer per rank.

brd_jarring_note.name: Jarring Note
brd_jarring_note.desc: A note nobody can talk over: stops what the target is casting, locks it for 3 seconds and silences it for one, with {dmg} storm damage. Does not use the global cooldown.

brd_sharper_note.name: Sharper Note
brd_sharper_note.desc: Discord Note hits harder per rank.

brd_ruin_finale.name: Ruin Finale
brd_ruin_finale.desc: The song's finale: {dmg} shadow damage to everything within 8 m of you, more the more it hits (up to +40%), a 1 second stun, and they take 10% more from everyone for 6 seconds. The Ruin capstone.

brd_song_of_mending.name: Song of Mending
brd_song_of_mending.desc: Strike up the song that heals: everyone within 10 m mends a little each second for 10 as it opens, and while you sing it heals land 10% harder on you and you are a little tougher. Your six slots become the Mending verses while it holds. Press again to stop; one song at a time.

brd_mending_verse.name: Mending Verse
brd_mending_verse.desc: {dmg} healing on a friend and a little more each second for 6. A short cast; works in any song.

brd_soothing_note.name: Soothing Note
brd_soothing_note.desc: A note that keeps mending: {dmg} healing a second on a friend for 8 seconds. Instant.

brd_lullaby.name: Lullaby
brd_lullaby.desc: Sing one of them to sleep: a 2 second stun and {dmg} shadow damage. From 25 m.

brd_kinder_verse.name: Kinder Verse
brd_kinder_verse.desc: Mending Verse heals for more per rank.

brd_chorus_of_life.name: Chorus of Life
brd_chorus_of_life.desc: Everyone within 10 m sings it back: {dmg} healing on every friend there and their poisons, slows and holds shaken off.

brd_lasting_chorus.name: Lasting Chorus
brd_lasting_chorus.desc: Soothing Note lasts longer per rank.

brd_mending_finale.name: Mending Finale
brd_mending_finale.desc: The song's finale: {dmg} healing on every friend within 12 m, mending for 8 seconds after, a ward on each of them, and every ill shaken off. The Mending capstone.

wishlist.rule: `cheatDeath: { hpPct: 25, secs: 10 }` on an ally-target skill: while it holds, the first blow that would kill the friend instead leaves them at hpPct and ends the effect. Written today as a ward + a small mend, which is the same money spent before the blow instead of after.

`grudge: { perHit: 0.1, max: 1.0, window: 10 }` on a weapon effect: +perHit x the number of hits the caster took in the last window seconds (capped). Settle the Grudge is written today as spendAll + perResourceSpent 2% per energy, which also reads as "spend what you have on one blow"; Payback is a flat 1.6x.

wishlist.field: spread (copy a dot to the pack)
wishlist.rule: `spread: { range: 6, max: 5 }` on an enemy-target skill: every dot on the target is copied (same per/secs/src, each under its own skill id) onto up to max foes within range. Written today as a circle at the target that applies the skill's OWN dot to each, which spreads one curse rather than all of them.

`needsCorpse: n` on a skill: refused unless n foes died within 12 m in the last 20 s (a corpse count the sim keeps per area). Raise Thrall and the Pyre work anywhere today, which keeps a Necromancer playable from the first pull.

`who: 'party+allies'` on a buff: fxPct on allies is read by nothing today (allies' basic() reads a.dmg flat), so a party buff never reaches a thrall. Grave Mending is a zone instead (zones DO heal allies); Howl's +10% is party-only.
As wave 2's Ice Wall: `wall: { secs: 4 }` on a line area. Written today as a 10 m line of fire with a 40% slow.
As wave 2's Grandeur; the Bard's songs could pay +damage per distinct verse sung. Nothing in wave 3 leans on it.

wishlist.field: stance bar slots that are not yet known
wishlist.rule: A bar may list a tree active the hero has not reached (e.g. the capstone); rankOf refuses it below its reqLevel so the level gate holds, but the client draws the slot like any other. Rule: the HUD dims a stance-bar slot whose skill is below the hero's level and shows "at level N".

wishlist.on: nec_unquiet_return, dru_green_return, dsk_second_dawn (and every wave 1-2 revive)
wishlist.rule: skills.js run() stamps p.lastFight = w.time BEFORE applying effects, and the revive effect asks w.time - p.lastFight > 5, so a skill revive can never fire. Rule: read lastFight into ctx before the stamp (or drop the gate for revives with a cast, since the cast already costs the time).
